This is the website for the ACRP project **EnergyProtect**, a collaborative project of GeoSphere Austria and AIT Austrian Institute of Technology (AIT hereafter).

We are a team of enthusiasts, meteorologists, machine learning users, etc. of GeoSphere Austria and AIT. 

We are (left to right): 
Sebastian Lehner (GeoSphere Austria), Kristofer Hasel (AIT), Marianne Bügelmayer-Blaschek (AIT), Jasmin Lampert (AIT), Annemarie Lexer (GeoSphere Austria), Theresa Schellander-Gorgas (GeoSphere Austria), Pascal Thiele (AIT), Irene Schicker (GeoSphere Austria, project lead), Axel Weißenfeld (AIT)

Not in this photo: Petrina Papazek and Raphael Spiekermann (GeoSphere Austria)

As of Spring 2024, this website is currently under development.
